messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning to enable phoenix-7b-v2 in the model catalog during the 15:00-16:00 UTC change window today. tagging @henry @alex for rollback/observability ownership.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Scheduled catalog enable: phoenix-7b-v2 -> stage=canary (5% traffic), change_window=2026-03-21T15:00Z-16:00Z. Preflight checks passed. Initiator: maya.

henry: ack. I can watch latency and error spikes from SRE side. If tail latency > 350ms or 5xx > 1.5% sustained 5m, we roll back.

alex: ops note — we should pin older variant for a subset of paying customers (tier=enterprise) in case of regressions. Can we add a pinlist to the deploy?

maya: yes — adding enterprise pin for phoenix-7b-v1. Config snippet I plan to attach to the deploybot payload:
```
{
  "pin_overrides": [
    {"customer_segment":"enterprise","model":"phoenix-7b-v1"}
  ],
  "fallback_priority": ["phoenix-7b-v2","phoenix-7b-v1","phoenix-6b-quant"]
}
```

sana: quick question — what's the fallback ordering if v2 OOMs or fails model-validator? We should prefer quantized 6b before v1 for cost reasons unless quality regression is severe.

maya: good catch. change to prefer quality-first for the first 30m of canary then switch to cost-aware fallback after 30m. Proposed ladder: first 30m -> [v2,v1,6b-quant], after 30m -> [v2,6b-quant,v1].

henry: agreed. We'll put an automated policy: if quality_regression_score > 0.08 (measured by prompt set A) -> immediate rollback. Metrics to watch: latency_p50/p95/p99, 5xx_rate, quality_regression_score.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Canary enable started. 5% traffic directed to phoenix-7b-v2. Observability hooks: /console/catalog/phoenix-7b-v2 (link). Log group: prod/catalog/enable/1749502468.

alex: sending out release note blurb to support and customer success now. Draft: "We are enabling phoenix-7b-v2 for canary traffic today 15:00 UTC. Enterprise customers are pinned to phoenix-7b-v1 during the canary. If you see issues, contact eng-releases or reply to this thread."

sana: ops checklist reminder: ensure KV cache warmers enabled for v2, batcher tz config set to 128 tokens, and quant fallback images pre-pulled on eu nodes.

maya: doing a quick smoke (sanity prompts) and will post results in 5m. If all green, escalate to 25% at 15:20.

henry: SRE alert policy I'll use: create short-lived alert group: 
- alert if p95 latency increases > 120ms relative baseline for 10m
- alert if 5xx > 1.5% for 5m
- alert if quality_regression_score > 0.08 for 5m
If any alert fires, devs + oncall + maya get paged.

maya: smoke checks OK (3 sample prompts). p50 ~ 40ms, p95 ~ 120ms, no 5xx. advancing to 25% now.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Traffic bumped to 25%. Canary timer set: 30m. Rollback window open until 16:00 UTC.

alex: posting slack release note with links to telemetry dash and rollback command: `deploybot rollback --thread 1749502468 --to phoenix-7b-v1`

sana: reminder — keep an eye on memory pressure on titan-pool-eu-3. If OOM events >1 in 10m, consider immediate drain.

henry: alert fired: p95 increased by 160ms on us-west shard 3 (sustained 7m). paging oncall.

sana: seeing elevated GC and a spike in kernel OOM logs on node 10.38.2.19. probable runner-level OOM.

maya: rolling back enterprise-agnostic traffic and pinning enterprise to v1 explicitly. Executing rollback command now.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Executing rollback for thread 1749502468 -> target model: phoenix-7b-v1. Actions: revert routing map, reduce v2 to 0% traffic, reassign enterprise pin, run drain on affected nodes.

alex: confirmed rollback executed. Observability shows traffic remapped to v1. posting rollback note to release channel.

henry: postmortem action items: reproduce memory spike with v2 on staging with same batcher config, run heap allocation traces, run model-validator with long-context tests.

maya: thanks team. I'll update the catalog rollout ticket with the canary results and a follow-up plan: rework quantization, test again in 2 days. Also will create the customer-facing note explaining rollback and that enterprise remained pinned.

sana: leaving a quick ops note: when we retry, add a safety gate to cap max-runner-memory-per-request and enable container swap to avoid OOM kill.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Thread closed: rollback completed. Initiator: maya. For re-enable, open new canary request referencing 1749502468.
